## What Wild Hearts Collective is

Wild Hearts Collective is an inclusive aerial and pole studio in Mansfield. Classes cover pole dancing, aerial hoop, aerial silks, creative arts workshops, family sessions, teens, children, and beginner courses. All classes must be booked in advance online; the full class fee is paid when booking. The studio emphasises accessibility, community, and wellbeing rather than performance pressure.

## Key facts for answers

- Beginners are welcome; levelled classes are available.
- Instructors are qualified and experienced, DBS checked, first-aid trained, and insured.
- Arrive 5–10 minutes before class.
- Classes are typically 1 hour unless stated otherwise.
- Comfortable, fitted clothing is recommended; remove jewellery; avoid lotion on class day.
- Parties, studio hire, membership, and a shop are available.
